subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is '**such**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the types of larger mammal species that lions may prey on.
 
• The term “such as” is used to introduce examples of a category, which in this case are rhinos and elephants as examples of larger mammal species.
 
• Other options like "like", "that", and "so" do not fit as naturally in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Lions are carnivores, which means they only *consume__* meat. They will eat almost any animal they can catch, however the most of the time it is buffalo, zebra, giraffe, warthog, and antelope species. If the *__opportunity__* arises, they will also prey on the young of larger mammal species *__such__* as rhinos and elephants. The majority of the preys will weigh between 50 and 300kg. Male lions can eat approximately 7 kg of meat per day. *__Whereas__* females eat approximately 4.5 kg. Both are *__capable__* of consuming up to 15% of their body weight in a single meal!*
